title: Persistence Resilience — Corrupt State Fallback
description: Dedicated verification that corrupt, partial, or version-mismatched localStorage never crashes the app and always yields a clean, usable default board.
spec:
1. Inject invalid JSON into the storage key and reload; confirm clean default board renders
2. Inject structurally-valid-but-wrong-shape JSON and reload; confirm graceful fallback
3. Inject a future/unknown version and reload; confirm no crash
4. Verify the app never shows a blank/error screen for any of the above
5. Verify a subsequent normal edit re-persists valid state
